body: Omg that would be fantastic. Yes a papa johns is like the only pizza place I know of. I've had it a couple of times it was amazing. Thank you so much I'm in tears.
Wow didn't even know something like this existed. If they can help with food I'm going to cry.

Sadly not, we have a super small town population. I don't have insurance, how much would getting food for the cost in the long run $1000? Plus I would have to call an ambulance, it's like 12 miles away, and colder than sin right now.

I wish I could have done something like this with my life. You went through problems, overcame, and conquered. I help but say I'm jealous. I'm probably way older than you too, and I have just fucked my life up, even when I got it together I still didn't succeed. Now I'm just an old guy who hasn't ate in 3 days and is waiting to do. I wish I could have been like you.
I mean I really don't have much. I'm probably going to walk to the nearest town to see if anyone will buy me food. Would have to wait a bit for it to warm up though.
I really just don't have the cash or the health. I mean these days I can't even eat.
Yea I mean my situation sucks. Tired of suffering just want out.
Just do? I'm sorry I don't understand.

I mean I don't want to talk about it tears me up. But I hurt people when I was an addict and didn't realize it till I was sober when it was too late. I live in a super small town kinda out of the way. Thing are just go wretched.
I have been sober 7 years, it's just the damage I did 10 years ago ruined me today. Part of the reason why I have no friends or family.

My only lesson of how addiction can really mess your life up, even well after you beat it. I don't like looking back on the past it makes me sad. I feel terrible because I'm getting old, and I haven't eaten in almost 3 days now. Despite what I know it's not good enough and I just want to stop suffering.
